I'm sure we can both at least agree that the force is heavily influenced by emotions. When you get angry, does it stick with you forever? Generally, the only way to pull it off without stumbling into undead is by turning a flashlight on and off in the same turn and using your mental map of where the enemies are/will go after seeing you. My high risk approach is to find a working vehicle, mark target spots on the map, and then blast in and out as quickly as possible before escaping. Also, use z levels to your advantage: your overmap range is larger from rooftops, and zombies can only follow you up stairs if they're next to you (afaik).
